Variables
cpct_pen2fourPixelM1_table

Mode 1 PEN to 4-pixels-byte in screen mode format conversion table

This table associates the value of a Mode 1 PEN ([0-3]) with a byte encoding 4-mode-1-pixels all of the PEN colour associated. For instance, for PEN 1, it associates 0xF0, which means 4-mode-1-pixels of PEN 1.
